claims.claim: The Collaboration Room is a closed permissionless TEST module with only ephemeral browser-memory output.
claims.passCondition: Manifest, contract and decision schema parse; output objects are closed; permissions are empty; lifecycle uses Workshop vocabulary; network, workspace, provider, execution, review-write and lifecycle authority are refused.
claims.counterevidence: An undeclared field, permission, external URL, durable storage, provider call or lifecycle claim exists.
claims.secondarySurfaceIfNeeded: focused source scan and verify.js module-contract verifier
claims.observedEvidence: Focused suite passed 68 checks after the lifecycle vocabulary was repaired; verify.js and verify-plus passed.

claims.claim: The same bounded human input produces the same unauthenticated decision draft and cannot inflate its authority.
claims.passCondition: Exact rebuild succeeds; unknown fields, unsupported decisions, missing trial digest, missing acknowledgement, noncanonical digest, control characters and truth inflation fail closed.
claims.counterevidence: A draft can claim authentication, signature, effect, installation, integration, promotion or CANON.
claims.observedEvidence: All adversarial draft checks passed, including the repaired raw-control-character case.

claims.claim: The room visibly separates the seven collaborators, one shared goal, four roots and the authority inspector at desktop width.
claims.passCondition: The captured desktop frame is legible, unclipped horizontally and visibly distinguishes active-route nodes from declared-only nodes.
claims.primarySurface: real in-app browser screenshot at the default desktop viewport
claims.counterevidence: Blank surface, overlapping primary controls, hidden root order, missing collaborator or misleading live-state presentation.
claims.observedEvidence: A 1265 by 712 browser frame showed all primary desktop columns, the constellation, root rail and explicit TEST/DECLARED/LOCKED states.

claims.claim: The room remains usable at a 390 by 844 narrow viewport.
claims.passCondition: Header, root rail, scenarios, constellation, inspector and decision controls stack without horizontal overflow.
claims.primarySurface: real in-app browser screenshots and measured document width
claims.counterevidence: Horizontal overflow, clipped controls, unreadable avatar labels or inaccessible decision actions.
claims.secondarySurfaceIfNeeded: semantic interaction at the narrow viewport
claims.observedEvidence: innerWidth 390, clientWidth and scrollWidth 375, horizontalOverflow false; scenario, Mirror inspector and HOLD draft controls remained clickable.

claims.claim: Scenario, collaborator and draft controls behave visibly while preserving the human-decision boundary.
claims.passCondition: Actor and scenario clicks update the correct state; missing trial digest refuses; exact digest plus acknowledgement emits only UNAUTHENTICATED_DRAFT with NONE authority/effect; reload clears it; Review Inbox link opens the existing route.
claims.counterevidence: A missing digest succeeds, a draft persists, the page claims authorization, or exact review is handled locally.
claims.secondarySurfaceIfNeeded: focused deterministic selftest and source scan
claims.observedEvidence: All named interactions passed; reload returned NO DRAFT; browser console had no errors or warnings.

claims.claim: AI provider and Mirror are live-connected and acting in this room.
claims.passCondition: Fresh provider and Mirror sender/receiver observations prove exact live connections.
claims.counterevidence: Only static declarations or visual labels are available.
claims.observedEvidence: No provider or Mirror call was made. The UI explicitly shows AI OFF BY DEFAULT and Mirror LIVE UNKNOWN.
